text: I went to get a filling and the dentist explained everything very well. She was calm, patient, and had a very gentle touch. I highly recommend her. The price is also very reasonable.
The doctor was very gentle and had a soft touch. It didn't hurt at all.

I had a tooth extracted today. The dentist was very gentle; I didn't feel anything at all.
I'd give him a perfect 10 out of 10!
author_name: นิรันทร์ สายวรรณ์

text:
The dentist is amazing!
So polite and calm, with an incredibly gentle touch. The tooth extraction was painless!
After the extraction, there was no swelling or inflammation... I was like, "Wow, did I really just get a tooth extracted?!"
The extraction cost only 600฿, which is fantastic.
The shop looks old-fashioned, but the dentist is extraordinary!

The shop is located under the yellow line train station on the On Nut side.
Try calling to make an appointment first. The dentist won't do anything that's not up-to-date, and he won't trick you or prolong the treatment unnecessarily.

Parking is available in front of the shop.
